info.description:

You can learn more about Kong Gateway at [developer.konghq.com](https://developer.konghq.com).

request.description: Updates the status of a particular application registration to an API. Approved application registrations will allow API traffic to the corresponding API. Revoked, rejected, or pending will not allow API traffic.

response.name: Details about the application registration being updated.

request.description:
Deletes an application registration, which if currently approved will immediately block API traffic to the API.
Note: Developers can request a new application registration for the given API as long as they have RBAC access to consume.
